I am trying to apply the GGIR package on ACC data which has another format than the regular sensors (range: +/- 2g). The read.myacc.csv function works and seems to define all the columns as supposed to. When I try to apply the following function: 

studyname="test"
f0 = 1
f1 = 2
g.shell.GGIR(datadir="C:/../ggir/input",
             outputdir="C:/../ggir/output",rmc.dec=".",rmc.firstrow.acc = 2, rmc.firstrow.header=c(),

             rmc.noise=0.0001,
             studyname=studyname,
             f0=f0,
             f1=f1,
             overwrite = FALSE,
             do.imp=TRUE,
             idloc=1,
             print.filename=FALSE,
             storefolderstructure = FALSE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 1 parameters:
             #-------------------------------
             windowsizes = c(5,900,3600),
             do.cal=TRUE,
             do.enmo = TRUE,
             do.anglez=TRUE,
             chunksize=1,
             printsummary=TRUE)

I get the following error:

Part 1

Checking that user has read access permission for all files in data directory: Yes

Checking that user has write access permission for directory specified by argument outputdir: Yes

Busy processing ... see C:/../ggir/output/output_input/meta/basic for progress

$call

    printsummary = printsummary, chunksize = chunksize, windowsizes = windowsizes,

    selectdaysfile = selectdaysfile, dayborder = dayborder, desiredtz = desiredtz,

    rmc.firstrow.header = rmc.firstrow.header, rmc.header.length = rmc.header.length,

    rmc.col.acc = rmc.col.acc, rmc.col.temp = rmc.col.temp, rmc.col.time = rmc.col.time,

    rmc.unit.acc = rmc.unit.acc, rmc.unit.temp = rmc.unit.temp,

    rmc.unit.time = rmc.unit.time, rmc.format.time = rmc.format.time,

    rmc.bitrate = rmc.bitrate, rmc.dynamic_range = rmc.dynamic_range,

    rmc.desiredtz = rmc.desiredtz, rmc.sf = rmc.sf, rmc.headername.sf = rmc.headername.sf,

    rmc.headername.sn = rmc.headername.sn, rmc.headername.recordingid = rmc.headername.sn,

    rmc.header.structure = rmc.header.structure, rmc.check4timegaps = rmc.check4timegaps,

    rmc.noise = rmc.noise, rmc.col.wear = rmc.col.wear, rmc.doresample = rmc.doresample)

Errors and warnings for ACC2a.csv$message

[1] "undefined columns selected"

 $call

`[.data.frame`(P, , c(rmc.col.time, rmc.col.acc, rmc.col.temp))

 ____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Part 2

Busy processing ... see C:/../ggir/output/output_input/meta/ms2.out for progress

Errors and warnings for NA$message

[1] "cannot open the connection"

$call

readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE)

Errors and warnings for NA$message

[1] "cannot open the connection"

$call

readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE)

 ____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Part 3

Can anybody help me with this error? Also, there is nothing in the meta folder (in output folder structure), is this normal? I am sorry if this is a trivial question, but it is the first time that I am using this package.

Greetings,
Emilie
